source_contracts.note: This plan changes neither the frozen biological endpoint nor field allocation. It fixes cross-taxon aggregation, evaluability, and reporting before prospective outcomes are opened.

unit_level_estimator.numerator: number of resolved COHORT_ARM_CANDIDATE_V1 units classified SEARCH_COMPLETED_DETECTED_VERIFIED
unit_level_estimator.denominator: number of resolved COHORT_ARM_CANDIDATE_V1 units classified either SEARCH_COMPLETED_DETECTED_VERIFIED or SEARCH_COMPLETED_NOT_DETECTED

primary_estimand.per_taxon_contrast: resolved binary success proportion in primary arm minus resolved binary success proportion in coverage-only arm
primary_estimand.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of the four predeclared per-taxon contrasts
primary_estimand.positive_direction: higher verified-current-occurrence recovery for structural-within-coverage ordering

primary_evaluability.per_taxon_requirement: For every one of CIR02, CIR06, CIR12 and CIR13, both the primary and coverage-only arms must each contain at least one resolved binary analysis unit.
primary_evaluability.partial_taxon_results_reporting: Report all available unit-level counts, proportions and contrasts descriptively, but do not replace the preregistered primary estimand with a favorable subset.

secondary_estimands.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of all four predeclared per-taxon contrasts
unweighted arithmetic mean of all four predeclared per-taxon contrasts

secondary_estimands.contrast: pooled resolved analysis-unit success proportions by arm and their pairwise differences
secondary_estimands.role: secondary descriptive only; never substitutes for the equal-taxon primary estimand
secondary_estimands.reason: Candidate counts and resolved denominators may differ among taxa, so pooled micro weighting would let larger/easier taxa dominate the primary conclusion.

sensitivity_reporting.leave_one_taxon_out_macro_values: report all four leave-one-taxon-out macro contrasts for the primary comparison when all four taxon contrasts are evaluable
sensitivity_reporting.role: predeclared influence diagnostic only; cannot replace the four-taxon primary estimand

uncertainty_and_decision.reason: With only four prospectively fresh taxa, the primary goal is an outcome-blind estimand and transparent taxon-level replication, not a post-hoc dichotomous significance gate.

claim_ceiling.if_primary_macro_positive: May be described as prospective evidence, within this predeclared four-taxon fresh-SENTINEL cohort and matched arm-symmetric PERSON_MINUTES_V1 schedules, that structural ordering inside coarse coverage added verified-current-occurrence recovery relative to coverage-only ordering.
claim_ceiling.if_primary_macro_zero_or_negative: Retain as a prospective null/negative result; do not retune the frozen structural families, coverage scale, candidate frame, effort allocation or aggregation on these outcomes and relabel the same cohort as confirmation.
claim_ceiling.if_primary_not_evaluable: Report PRIMARY_FOUR_TAXON_MACRO_NOT_EVALUABLE and the complete available per-taxon state counts; do not drop or replace taxa to manufacture an evaluable primary.
not_authorized: optimal field days or monetary budget
